output.scope_note: The paper introduces TOPIC, a structure-prediction method for oxide Li solid electrolytes, and reports MD-derived Li ionic conductivities for several predicted candidates.

records.measurement_method: MLIP (SevenNet-0) MD with Arrhenius extrapolation to 300 K
records.evidence_quote: Notably, Li4Hf2Si3O12 exhibits a high Liion conductivity of 14.09 mS cm−1
records.notes: Computed, not measured. Value is extrapolated to 300 K from MLIP-MD at 800-1200 K. Activation energy 0.183 eV is from Table 2 (Li4Hf2Si3O12 (I), Ea = 0.183 ± 0.016 eV), not from the quoted sentence. Table 2 gives sigma300K = 14.090 (7.569, 26.229) mS cm−1. Abstract rounds this to 14 mS cm−1.
